sources.title: Torchaudio is unavailable for cu132 torch #14232 - GitHub
sources.snippet: For cu126/cu130, torchaudio 2.11.0 is compatiable with torch>=2.11.0 so there's no problem. However for the latest cuda version cu132 there's no stable torchaudio wheel available, and I tried to use torchaudio nightly wheel but end up with dll mismatch.
